column1: # A worked site resource policy for a cluster of 48-core, 384000 MB nodes on a shared
# partition, with 96-core large-memory nodes and two GPU nodes (4 x A100, 6 x L40S), derived
# from ten real 20-25x samples (docs/guide/12-resources.md, "A worked policy"). Copy it to
# <prefix>/resources.tsv and adjust the time limits to your queue. Rows apply in file order and
# a later row's cells override an earlier row's, so the catch-all comes first.
task
# every task that no row below names: the small ones run in minutes; a short limit lets SLURM backfill them
# alignment: 32 cores would leave 16 of 48 idle; two 24-core jobs fill a node (the command keeps
# 32 threads, a mild oversubscription). Whole-BAM alignment (use_alignment_chunking false) takes
# about 20 minutes per BAM; chunked jobs take 2 minutes and the limit could be 30 minutes
pbmm2_align_wgs
pbsamoa_merge
index_input_bam
create_pbmm2_index
# small variants: make_examples 8 x 8 cores (six per node), call_variants a whole node (the cap)
deepvariant_make_examples
deepvariant_call_variants_cpu
deepvariant_postprocess_variants
# memory asked far above the observed peak: three sawfish per node instead of two, HiPhase no
# longer blocks 96 GB for a 5 GB peak
sawfish_discover
hiphase
trgt_genotype
paraphase
# assembly: hifiasm takes a whole standard node (81 GB peak at 21x); the fat partition only for
# outliers (uncomment the partition cell); minimap2 asks 128 GB for a 32 GB peak
ugc_wgw_hifiasm_assemble
ugc_wgw_yak_count
ugc_wgw_minimap2_align_asm
# GPU: Parabricks with 4 GPUs is one job per GPU node; on the 6-GPU node a 3-GPU, 32-core,
# 160 GB shape (parabricks_gpus 3 in config.json plus this row) runs two at once
#run_parabricks_deepvariant
